title: WTO And Services
definition: The WTO framework governing international trade in services is institutionalized under the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), which came into force in 1995 as a result of the Uruguay Round negotiations.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper III (Economy - Service Sector, Global Trade, International Institutions) and Prelims (GATS modes, plurilateral negotiations, and India's stance at WTO).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of WTO And Services.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of international trade
